name: Lizzie Buckley Trumbo
sources: John Holmes Trumbo, handwritten key to the Chehalis house photograph, 1957 (Turner / Harvey Family Tree on Ancestry.com)
notes: Child of Presley Nevil and Hannah (Buckley) Trumbo; an older sister of Serena Trumbo Adams. Named, with her birth year, in John Holmes Trumbo's 1957 key to the family photograph at their Chehalis house.
